detailed_description:
A high-tech, dramatic sci-fi scene set in the cold, green-lit Core Control Room (<Subject 4>), focusing on the tense revelation of a global energy conspiracy.

[Shot 1] At 00:00, the shot opens with a medium close-up from Ella's (<Subject 6>) right side at eye level, slowly pushing in. Ella is positioned on the left side of the frame, her jaw tightly clenched in suppressed anger, while the right side of the frame displays the glowing archive of Dr. Orwell (<Subject 2>) and the shifting consciousness nodes on the console screen. The cold green light of the display screen (<Subject 4>) illuminates her face, while an orange rim light elegantly outlines her full-metal cybernetic left arm (<Subject 6>). Her mechanical fingertips slide along the glass of the holographic interface, pulling up the clock tower core structure. In the background, Marcus (<Subject 3>) remains still and silent, listening intently. Ella speaks in a suppressed, angry tone: `<d>[Chinese] 奥威尔博士骗了所有人。钟塔的真正燃料是人类的灵魂。`</d> The sound of the database switching and the mechanical fingertips scraping against the glass punctuates the tense atmosphere.

At 00:06, the shot transitions to a wide-to-medium shot from a slightly low angle below the screen, slowly pulling out. The composition shifts to show the three characters standing at the bottom of the frame—Ella (<Subject 6>) on the left, UNIT-7 (<Subject 1>) in the center, and Marcus (<Subject 3>) on the right, spaced about 1.5 meters apart—while the upper half of the frame is dominated by the massive twelve-clock-tower network map of the global energy grid. Twelve cold green nodes light up sequentially, casting the characters into dark silhouettes. Ella expands the network display, and one million consciousness nodes appear beneath each clock tower. Marcus looks up at the glowing map, and a weak green flash pulses through the vacuum tubes in UNIT-7's (<Subject 1>) chest. Ella speaks in a restrained, quiet voice: `<d>[Chinese] 每座钟塔收割100万人的意识，转化为计算力维持全球能源网络。`</d> The sequential ringing of the twelve nodes and a low, deep neural network hum fill the audio. As the shot ends, the underground connection map on the screen locks onto a hidden door, and UNIT-7's chest vacuum tubes return to their steady orange glow. Marcus has relaxed his arrest posture, standing shoulder to shoulder with Ella, while the rear security door remains open, leading toward the Maintenance Corridor (<Subject 5>).
